name: hh-quote-builder
description: Him & Her Music wedding quote builder — WordPress plugin

scripts.build:emails: mjml email-templates/client.mjml -o email-templates/client.html && mjml email-templates/customer.mjml -o email-templates/customer.html
scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/nav.js && node --check src/bridge.js && node --check src/inject.js
scripts.version: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version, fs=require('fs'); let f=fs.readFileSync('hh-quote-builder.php','utf8'); f=f.replace(/Version:\s+[\d\.]+/, 'Version: '+v); fs.writeFileSync('hh-quote-builder.php',f);" && npm run build
